Necrosi (spesso a pseudopalizzata) e pro:
Necrosis (often pseudopalisading) and microvascular proliferation are the histological criteria for grade 4 in diffuse gliomas. In the WHO 2021 classification glioblastoma is IDH-wildtype by definition; the historical TCGA-GBM cases are largely IDH-wildtype, but this patient's IDH status is not reported here.
Radiological correlation: the central necrosis corresponds to the non-enhancing centre of the ring lesion, microvascular proliferation to the thick, irregular enhancement of the wall and to the increased blood volume on perfusion (rCBV). The surrounding T2/FLAIR hyperintense oedema contains infiltrating tumour cells: this is why recurrence almost always occurs at the margin of the cavity.
Glioma con necrosi o proliferazione micr: Glioma with necrosis or microvascular proliferation = grade 4; on MRI it is the thick, irregular ring with a necrotic centre.
